title: The dualizing coefficient map commutes with the site unit
statement: For finite commutative A,B, φ:A→B, a compactifiable f:X→Y with Y Noetherian, scalar extension of finiteGeneralRingDualizingUnitMap A f followed by proCoefficientMap at the A coefficient unit and the exceptional image of finiteGeneralRingScalarUnitIso equals pbcComparisonReduction at the ordinary dualizing complex followed by comparison of the ordinary dualizingScalarMap and finiteGeneralRingDualizingUnitMap B f.

proof.text: Expand the transported pro-etale exceptional coefficient map. Naturality of the site/scalar comparison moves the A dualizing-unit map past its first factor. Naturality of the ordinary exceptional coefficient mate moves the A site-adjunction unit past that mate. The scalar-unit/origin equation identifies the remaining origin composite with the ordinary scalar-unit isomorphism followed by the B site unit. Functoriality identifies the result with the defining ordinary dualizing coefficient map followed by the B dualizing-unit map.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarDualizingUnit_square
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [HasCompactification f] :
    (Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.proScalar φ X).map (finiteGeneralRingDualizingUnitMap A f) ≫
      Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.proCoefficientMap φ f (finiteGeneralRingUnit A Y) ≫
      (Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.exceptional B f).map
        (finiteGeneralRingScalarUnitIso φ Y).hom =
    (pbcComparisonReduction X φ).hom.app
        (Etale.dualizingComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f) ≫
      (Etale.FiniteSmoothPurity.comparison B X).map
        (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.dualizingScalarMap φ f) ≫
      finiteGeneralRingDualizingUnitMap B f
